tasks.title: Lecture #14
tasks.instruction: Listen to a short talk on biology.
tasks.transcript: Today, we are going to continue our discussion of social insects, focusing on the Argentine ant, which as u might guess is a species of ant that are natives to Argentina. We’ll consider what happened to this type of ant after some members of the species move to California from their original habitat. Ok, well, in Argentina, these Argentine ants behave like most ant species around the world. They fight other ants of the same species if those ants are from some other nests. But the Argentine ants living in California behave differently. Ants from different nests form a single large colony. Within this colony, there is little aggression among ants from different nests. And when they fight insects from outside their colony, the Argentine ants can quickly recruit a huge army from their network of nests. This of course gives them advantages over other ants’ species. So then, why do Argentine ants behave differently in California than they do in Argentina? Well, using genetic testing, researches found that all the Argentine ants in California were very similar genetically. You see, when the first Argentine ants came to California, their population must have been very small， and all the later generations of Argentine ants there must be descended from the same few ancestors. So they are all closely related. This discovery is important, because for most social insects, membership in a colony is based on how closely related they are genetically.

questions.stem: What aspect of Argentine ant is mainly discussed?

options.A: How they behave toward ants from other nests.
options.D: Why they were brought to California

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：主要讨论了阿根廷蚁的哪个方面？ 定位原文： We’ll consider what happened to this type of ant after some members of the species move to California from their original habitat. ... In Argentina, these Argentine ants behave like most ant species around the world. They fight other ants of the same species if those ants are from some other nests. But the Argentine ants living in California behave differently. Ants from different nests form a single large colony. Within this colony, there is little aggression among ants from different nests. 选项分析： A. How they behave toward ants from other nests（它们如何对待来自其他巢穴的蚂蚁）。讲话通篇对比阿根廷蚁在阿根廷本土和加利福尼亚对来自其他巢穴同类的不同行为，因此A选项正确。 B. What they usually eat（它们通常吃什么）。基于讲话未讨论阿根廷蚁的饮食，所以B选项错误。 C. Why they are becoming extinct（它们为什么正在灭绝）。讲话未提及灭绝问题，所以C选项错误。 D. Why they were brought to California（它们为什么被带到加利福尼亚）。讲话提到阿根廷蚁迁移到加利福尼亚，但未解释原因，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the professor say about Argentine ants that live in Argentina?

options.A: They protect Argentine ants that live in neighboring nests.
options.B: They gather food with Argentine ants from other nests.
options.C: They fight Argentine ants from other nests.
options.D: They generally build larger nests than other ant species do.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：教授对生活在阿根廷的阿根廷蚁有什么说法？ 定位原文： In Argentina, these Argentine ants behave like most ant species around the world. They fight other ants of the same species if those ants are from some other nests. 选项分析： A. They protect Argentine ants that live in neighboring nests（它们保护生活在邻近巢穴的阿根廷蚁）。基于讲话未提及保护行为，所以A选项错误。 B. They gather food with Argentine ants from other nests（它们与来自其他巢穴的阿根廷蚁一起采集食物）。讲话未讨论合作觅食，所以B选项错误。 C. They fight Argentine ants from other nests（它们与来自其他巢穴的阿根廷蚁打斗）。讲话明确指出它们会与其他巢穴的同种蚂蚁打斗，因此C选项正确。 D. They generally build larger nests than other ant species do（它们通常比其他种类的蚂蚁建造更大的巢穴）。讲话未比较巢穴大小，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What’s the characteristic of Argentine ants in California?

options.A: They attack members of their own nests.
options.B: They recruit ants from other species into their nests.
options.C: They form large colonies made of several nests.
options.D: They hide from insects that attack their nests.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：加利福尼亚的阿根廷蚁有什么特征？ 定位原文： But the Argentine ants living in California behave differently. Ants from different nests form a single large colony. Within this colony, there is little aggression among ants from different nests. And when they fight insects from outside their colony, the Argentine ants can quickly recruit a huge army from their network of nests. 选项分析： A. They attack members of their own nests（它们攻击自己巢穴的成员）。讲话提到不同巢穴之间几乎没有攻击行为，更未提及攻击同巢成员，所以A选项错误。 B. They recruit ants from other species into their nests（它们将其他种类的蚂蚁招募到自己的巢穴中）。讲话提到从巢穴网络中召集“军队”，但召集的是同种蚂蚁，而非其他物种，所以B选项错误。 C. They form large colonies made of several nests（它们形成由多个巢穴组成的大型群体）。讲话明确指出不同巢穴的蚂蚁形成一个大型群体，因此C选项正确。 D. They hide from insects that attack their nests（它们躲避攻击其巢穴的昆虫）。讲话提到它们会与群体外的昆虫战斗，而非躲避，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What did genetic testing indicate about the Argentine ants in California?

options.A: They share the same few ancestors.
options.B: They can't be distinguished from native Californian ants.
options.C: They are evolving faster than native Californian ants.
options.D: Their future survival is in doubt.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：基因测试表明加利福尼亚的阿根廷蚁有什么特点？ 定位原文： Using genetic testing, researches found that all the Argentine ants in California were very similar genetically. You see, when the first Argentine ants came to California, their population must have been very small, and all the later generations of Argentine ants there must be descended from the same few ancestors. So they are all closely related. 选项分析： A. They share the same few ancestors（它们源自相同的少数祖先）。讲话明确指出所有加利福尼亚的阿根廷蚁都源自相同的少数祖先，因此A选项正确。 B. They can't be distinguished from native Californian ants（它们无法与加利福尼亚本地蚂蚁区分）。基于讲话未比较阿根廷蚁与本地蚂蚁的区别，所以B选项错误。 C. They are evolving faster than native Californian ants（它们比加利福尼亚本地蚂蚁进化得更快）。讲话未讨论进化速度，所以C选项错误。 D. Their future survival is in doubt（它们未来的生存存疑）。讲话未提及生存前景，所以D选项错误。
